verses.en: And Ahab had seventy sons in Samaria. And Jehu wrote letters, and sent to Samaria, unto the rulers of Jezreel, to the elders, and to them that brought up Ahab's children, saying,
verses.sm: SA i Samaria foi o atalii o Aapo eJQ toafitugafulu. Ua tusi foi e leu o tusi, ma avatu ai i Samaria, i alii o Isereelu o toeaina, atoa foi ma i latou na tausi i fanau a Aapo, ua faapea atu,

verses.en: Now as soon as this letter cometh to you, seeing your master's sons are with you, and there are with you chariots and horses, a fenced city also, and armour;
verses.sm: A oo atu lenei tusi ia te outou, o ia te outou atalii o lo outou alii, e ia te outou foi kariota, ma solofanua, o le aai foi o nofo ‘olo, atoa ma auupega ;

verses.en: Look even out the best and meetest of your master's sons, and set him on his father's throne, and fight for your master's house.
verses.sm: ia outou filifili se atalii o lo outou alii, o se ua sili ma le tatau, ia outou faanofo foi ia te ia i le nofoalii o lona tamā, ma ia outou sauni tau mai ona o le aiga o lo outou alii.

verses.en: But they were exceedingly afraid, and said, Behold, two kings stood not before him: how then shall we stand?
verses.sm: A ua matuā matatau lava i latou, ua faapea ane, Faauta, e lei tutū tupu e toalua i ona luma, pe faapefea ona tatou tutū ai ?

verses.en: And he that was over the house, and he that was over the city, the elders also, and the bringers up of the children, sent to Jehu, saying, We are thy servants, and will do all that thou shalt bid us; we will not make any king: do thou that which is good in thine eyes.
verses.sm: Ona ave ai lea ia Ieu o le feau a le na pule i le aiga, ma le na pule i le aai, ma toeaina, atoa ma e tausia tama, ua faapea mai, O au auauna i matou, matou te faia mea uma e te fetalai mai ai; matou te le faia se tupu ; ina faia ia oe o le mea e te finagalo i ai.

verses.en: Then he wrote a letter the second time to them, saying, If ye be mine, and if ye will hearken unto my voice, take ye the heads of the men your master's sons, and come to me to Jezreel by to morrow this time. Now the king's sons, being seventy persons, were with the great men of the city, which brought them up.
verses.sm: Ona toe tusi faalua atu ai lea o ia ia te i latou, ua faapea atu, Afai ua ia te au outou, ma outou usiusitai i a‘u upu, ki outou au mai i ulu o ia tagata o atalii o lo outou alii, i le tou o mai ai ia te au i Isereelu a taeao i le itu la faapenei. Na i ai foi atalii o le tupu e toafitugafulu tagata i alii o le aai, na latou tausi ia te i latou.

w.en: then wrote a second time to

verses.en: And it came to pass, when the letter came to them, that they took the king's sons, and slew seventy persons, and put their heads in baskets, and sent him them to Jezreel.
verses.sm: Ua oo atu le tusi ia te i latou, ona latou ave ai lea o atalii o le tupu, ma latou fāsioti i tagata ia e toafitugafulu, ua fafao foi o latou ulu i ato, ma avatu ai ia te ia i Isereelu.

verses.en: And there came a messenger, and told him, saying, They have brought the heads of the king's sons. And he said, Lay ye them in two heaps at the entering in of the gate until the morning.
verses.sm: Ona sau ai lea o le sāvali, ua ta‘u mai ia te ia, ua faapea mai, Ua latou au mai ulu o atalii o le tupu. Ona fai atu ai lea o ia, Ia outou tuuina i faupuega e lua i le puipui o le faitotoa seia taeao.

verses.en: And it came to pass in the morning, that he went out, and stood, and said to all the people, Ye be righteous: behold, I conspired against my master, and slew him: but who slew all these?
verses.sm: Ua oo i le taeao, ona alu atu ai lea o ia, ua tu atu, ma fai atu i le nuu uma, Ua amiotonu outou, faauta mai, na ou foua e a‘u lo‘u alii, ma fasioti ia te ia; a o ai ea na fasioti ia te i latou nei uma?

verses.en: Know now that there shall fall unto the earth nothing of the word of the LORD, which the LORD spake concerning the house of Ahab: for the LORD hath done that which he spake by his servant Elijah.
verses.sm: O lenei, ia outou iloa e le iuvale se mea e tasi o afioga a Ieova, sa fetalai mai ai Ieova i le aiga o Aapo; a ua faia e Ieova le mea sa na fetalaia mai i lana auauna o Elia.

verses.en: So Jehu slew all that remained of the house of Ahab in Jezreel, and all his great men, and his kinsfolks, and his priests, until he left him none remaining.
verses.sm: Na fāsia e Ieu o i latou uma na totoe o le aiga o Aapo i Isereelu, atoa ma alii uma sa ia te ia ma ana aumea, ma ana ositaulaga, ua oo ina le faatotoe e ia se toatasi ia te ia.

verses.en: And he arose and departed, and came to Samaria. And as he was at the shearing house in the way,
verses.sm: Ona tulai ai lea o ia, ua alu atu, o le a alu i Samaria, ua i le fale e fusi ai mamoe e leoleo mamoe, sa i le ala lea.

verses.en: Jehu met with the brethren of Ahaziah king of Judah, and said, Who are ye? And they answered, We are the brethren of Ahaziah; and we go down to salute the children of the king and the children of the queen.
verses.sm: Ona maua ai lea e Ieu uso o Aasaia le tupu o Iuta ; ua na fai atu foi, O ai ea outou na? Ona fai mai ai lea o i latou, O uso o Aasaia i rnatou, o loo o ifo foi i matou e fealofani ma alo o le tupu, atoa ma alo o le masiofo.

verses.en: And he said, Take them alive. And they took them alive, and slew them at the pit of the shearing house, even two and forty men; neither left he any of them.
verses.sm: Ona fai atu ai lea o ia, Ina pue ola ia ia te i latou. Ona latou pue ola lea ia te i latou, ma fāsioti ia te i latou, i le lua o le fale e fusi ai mamoe, o tagata e toafagafulu ma le toalua; e lei faatoe lava e ia so latou.

verses.en: And when he was departed thence, he lighted on Jehonadab the son of Rechab coming to meet him: and he saluted him, and said to him, Is thine heart right, as my heart is with thy heart? And Jehonadab answered, It is. If it be, give me thine hand. And he gave him his hand; and he took him up to him into the chariot.
verses.sm: Ua alu ese ia i lea mea, ona iloa ai lea e ia o Ionatapa le atalii o Rakapa, ua faafetaiai mai ia te ia. Ona alofa atu ai lea ia te ia, ua fai atu i ai, Po ua tonu mai ea lou loto, faapei o lo‘u loto i lou loto ? Ona fai mai ai lea o Ionatapa, O lea lava. Afai ua faapea, au mai ia lou lima. Ona au mai ai lea e ia o lona lima; ona ia avae ai lea o ia ia la faatasi i le kariota.

verses.en: And he said, Come with me, and see my zeal for the LORD. So they made him ride in his chariot.
verses.sm: Ona fai'atu ai lea o ia, Ia ta o ma a‘u, e te iloa ai lo‘u maelega ia leōva. Ua latou fai atu ia te ia e tietie i lona kariota.

verses.en: And when he came to Samaria, he slew all that remained unto Ahab in Samaria, till he had destroyed him, according to the saying of the LORD, which he spake to Elijah.
verses.sm: Ua oo ia i Samaria, ona fasi uma ai lea e ia i e na totoe o sa Aapō i Samaria, ua oo ina faaumatia o ia, faapei o le afioga a Ieova, na ia fetalai mai ia Elia.

verses.en: And Jehu gathered all the people together, and said unto them, Ahab served Baal a little; but Jehu shall serve him much.
verses.sm: Ona faapotopoto ai lea e Ieu o le nuu uma, ua fai atu ia te i latou, Sa auauna faaitiiti Aapo ia Paala, a e tele ona auauna o Ieu ia te ia.

verses.en: Now therefore call unto me all the prophets of Baal, all his servants, and all his priests; let none be wanting: for I have a great sacrifice to do to Baal; whosoever shall be wanting, he shall not live. But Jehu did it in subtilty, to the intent that he might destroy the worshippers of Baal.
verses.sm: O lenei, ina faapotopoto mai ia ia te au o perofeta uma a Paala, o ana auauna uma, atoa ma ana ositaulaga uma; aua ne‘i nofo se tasi; auā o le a fai la‘u taulaga tele ia Paala; ai se nofo e le ola ia. A ua faia lea mea e Ieu ma le faa‘ole‘ole, ina ia faaumatia e ia o e auauna ia Paala.

verses.en: And Jehu said, Proclaim a solemn assembly for Baal. And they proclaimed it.
verses.sm: Ua fai atu Ieu, Tala‘i ia o se nunu ia Paala. Ona latou tala‘i ai lea.

verses.en: And Jehu sent through all Israel: and all the worshippers of Baal came, so that there was not a man left that came not. And they came into the house of Baal; and the house of Baal was full from one end to another.
verses.sm: Ua ave foi le feau a Ieu ia Isaraelu uma; ona o mai ai lea auauna uma lava a Paala, e lei toe se tasi tagata e le o sau. Ua latou ulufale foi i le fale o Paala, ua tumu saisai ai le fale o Paala.

verses.en: And he said unto him that was over the vestry, Bring forth vestments for all the worshippers of Baal. And he brought them forth vestments.
verses.sm: Ona fai atu ai lea o ia i le na leoleo i le fale e tuu ai ofu, Au mai ia o ofu mo i latou uma o e auauna ia Paala. Ona au mai ai lea e ia o ofu mo i latou.

verses.en: And Jehu went, and Jehonadab the son of Rechab, into the house of Baal, and said unto the worshippers of Baal, Search, and look that there be here with you none of the servants of the LORD, but the worshippers of Baal only.
verses.sm: Ona alu ai lea o Ieu, o i laua ma Ionatapa le atalii o Rakapa, i le fale o Paala, ma na fai atu i e auauna ia Paala, Suesue ia, ma ia iloa ina ne‘i iinei ia te outou se auauna ia Ieova, i'a na o e auauna ia Paala lava.

verses.en: And when they went in to offer sacrifices and burnt offerings, Jehu appointed fourscore men without, and said, If any of the men whom I have brought into your hands escape, he that letteth him go, his life shall be for the life of him.
verses.sm: Ua latou ulufale atu e fai ai taulaga ma taulaga mu; ona tofia lea i fafo e Ieu o tagata e toavalugafulu, ua fai atu foi, A sao se tasi o ia tagata ua ou au mai i o outou lima, e suia o ia i so outou.

verses.en: And it came to pass, as soon as he had made an end of offering the burnt offering, that Jehu said to the guard and to the captains, Go in, and slay them; let none come forth. And they smote them with the edge of the sword; and the guard and the captains cast them out, and went to the city of the house of Baal.
verses.sm: Ua uma ona faia le taulaga mu, ona fai atu ai lea o leu i le ‘au e faafeao, ma e taʻi ‘au, Ulufale atu ia, ina fāsioti ia te i latou, ne‘i sao i fafo se tasi. Ona latou fāsioti ai lea ia te i latou i le pelu, ua lafoai foi i latou i fafo e le ‘au e faafeao ma e taʻi ‘au. Ona latou o ai lea i le aai o le fale o Paala.

verses.en: And they brought forth the images out of the house of Baal, and burned them.
verses.sm: Ona latou au mai ai lea i fafo o tupua ai le fale o Paala, ma latou susunu ai.

verses.en: And they brake down the image of Baal, and brake down the house of Baal, and made it a draught house unto this day.
verses.sm: Ua latou lepeti i le tupua o Paala, ua latou lepeti foi i le fale o Paala, ua fai ai ma māliuga, ua oo lava i le aso nei.

verses.en: Thus Jehu destroyed Baal out of Israel.
verses.sm: O lenei, ua faaumatia Paala e Ieu i Isaraelu.

verses.en: Howbeit from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin, Jehu departed not from after them, to wit, the golden calves that were in Beth-el, and that were in Dan.
verses.sm: A e peitai ua le liliu ese lava Ieu i agasala a Ierepoamo le atalii o Nepata, o le na faatupu le agasala ia Isaraelu; o tamai povi auro foi ia na i ai i Peteli atoa foi ma Tanu.

verses.en: And the LORD said unto Jehu, Because thou hast done well in executing that which is right in mine eyes, and hast done unto the house of Ahab according to all that was in mine heart, thy children of the fourth generation shall sit on the throne of Israel.
verses.sm: Ona fetalai mai lea o Ieova ia Ieu, Ua lelei lau mea na fai ina ua e faia le mea tonu i o‘u luma, ma ua e faia i le aiga o Aapo e tusa ma mea uma na ou loto i ai, o le mea lea e nonofo ai ou atalii i le nofoālii o Isaraelu e oo i le fa o tupulaga.

verses.en: But Jehu took no heed to walk in the law of the LORD God of Israel with all his heart: for he departed not from the sins of Jeroboam, which made Israel to sin.
verses.sm: A e lei anaana Ieu e savali i le tulafono a Ieova le Atua o Isaraelu ma lona loto atoa; ina ua le liliu ese i agasala a Ierepoamo, o le na faatupu le agasala ia Isaraelu.

verses.en: In those days the LORD began to cut Israel short: and Hazael smote them in all the coasts of Israel;
verses.sm: O ia ona po na amata ai e Ieova ona faaitiitiina o Isaraelu ; na fāsia foi e Asaeli o i latou i itu uma o Isaraelu,

verses.en: From Jordan eastward, all the land of Gilead, the Gadites, and the Reubenites, and the Manassites, from Aroer, which is by the river Arnon, even Gilead and Bashan.
verses.sm: e amata i Ioritana i le itu e alu ae ai le la, o le nuu uma o Kiliata, o sa Katō, ma sa Reupenā, atoa ma sa Manase, e amata i Aroeru e latalata i le alia o Arinona, o Kiliata atoa ma Vasana.

verses.en: Now the rest of the acts of Jehu, and all that he did, and all his might, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
verses.sm: O toe o mea na faia e Ieu ma mea uma na ia faia, atoa ma lona fitafita uma, e lei tusia ea i le tusi o tala i nofoaiga a tupu o Isaraelu ?

verses.en: And Jehu slept with his fathers: and they buried him in Samaria. And Jehoahaz his son reigned in his stead.
verses.sm: Ua taoto foi Ieu faatasi ma ona tamā; ua latou tanu ia te ia i Samaria; ona soloai ane ai lea o Ioasasa lona atalii e fai ma tupu.

verses.en: And the time that Jehu reigned over Israel in Samaria was twenty and eight years.
verses.sm: O aso foi na fai ai Ieu ma tupu ia Isaraelu i Samaria, e luafulu ma le valu o tausaga ia. O lefasiga o le aiga o le tupu o luta
